title: MotifGraph (motif-graph@1)
$comment: GENERATED by src-v9/build/gen_schemas.py from the node registry in the graph module. Do not edit by hand.
description: The "graph" of a layer (layer scope) or of a project (composite scope): a data-only node stack. Stage (exactly one, first), Cloner (at most one), Fields, Effectors, Deformers. Parameters are project channels addressed M:<layerId or @>:<nodeId>:<key>.

place.description: Composite scope only: before or after the finishing stack.

anyOf.description: Stage: Mesh detail, camera, lighting and the mix with the original
